name: core-input
title: Core: input modality
description: One attribute on the root, data-sg-input, that says whether a moving key (an arrow, Home, End, Page Up or Down) is held or the last input was a pointer, so CSS can drop motion from repeated keyboard actions. Installed on import; core-component imports it. The touch contract's keyboard rule (docs/contributing/touch-contract.md).

budget.reason: The touch contract: a pure key tracker (tested in Node) and four listeners installed once, trimmed to the code and one header.

motif.gloss: No cultural motif; shared infrastructure, nothing drawn from a tradition.
